title: CN/V20261019 exact battle-value expressions
$comment: CN-advanced-3.1.0 II.B-01..03 PDF p19–20 and II.D-15..17 PDF p50–51 (one-based). Printed arithmetic is separate from runtime facts and later damage modifiers. BigInt intermediates; final safe signed Number, or final negative-clamped nonnegative ten-point damage. damage.coins reads only the current attack execution's host-projected counts, never RNG/receipts or parent/copied/foreign fallbacks. Evidence syntax does not approve a card.

pokemonField.description: specialConditions: how many of the five Special Conditions (I.F) the Pokémon is affected by (「所处于的特殊状态数量」).

previousOpponentTurn.description: What happened in the user's latest opponent turn (II.E-11; checkup is not a turn): damageTaken = the attack damage THIS Pokémon took then (activeOnly: only while Active; 「在上一个对手的回合，这只宝可梦所受到的招式的伤害」), prizesTaken = the Prize cards the opponent took then (「在上一个对手的回合，对手所拿取的奖赏卡张数」). 0 when there was no such turn.

extraEnergy.description: energy.extra 「如果追加附有N个（【X】）能量的话」: how many Energy units able to provide energyType (any unit when null) the user of THIS attack has beyond the attack's current cost (D-11/D-12 changes included), in the best payment. Attacks only.

energyTypes.description: 「追加附有【超】能量和【恶】能量各1个」: 1 when one payment of the cost leaves a different extra unit for each listed type at once, else 0.

movedCards.description: How many of the cards an earlier counted effect of THIS attack execution actually moved match a selector (「造成其中能量的张数×N」). The host answers from the effect's own record; a missing record is an error, never zero.

distinct.description: 「…的属性种类数量」: how many different printed types those cards show (a Basic Energy's type, a Pokémon's types; other cards none), not how many cards.

pokemon.description: Read a host-derived effective stat, not a printed CardDefinition field. Damage counters, HP points, physical Energy cards and supplied Energy units are distinct units. No conversion or fallback.

prizes.description: Read count from the original prize-count query result for this side. needsRuling is never zero or a numeric count.

coin.description: Read one named roll in this exact attack execution. The host supplies a plain own-key map at facts.coins, with each requested key containing exactly own enumerable data heads/tails/flips: nonnegative safe integers satisfying BigInt(heads)+BigInt(tails)==BigInt(flips). Missing rolls are errors, never zero. Other keys are not scanned. No RNG, receipt, owner, scope or parent-execution override.

effectCards.description: CN II.B-02 p20 / II.D-02 文例1 p42: the number of physical cards that an earlier counted effect of THIS attack execution actually moved (e.g. discarded attached Energy). The host supplies facts.effectCards[effectId]; a missing effect is an error, never zero.

pokemonState.description: Current in-play state: damage counters on it (or, undamaged, none), at least one attached Tool card, at least one Ability currently in effect (II.D-13 FAQ2: a Pokémon whose Abilities are all cancelled does not count), affected by any listed Special Condition, or at least one attached Energy card matching energy (「身上附有（【X】／特殊）能量的宝可梦」; providedTypes = currently providing that type, II.D-08 FAQ).

undamaged.description: 「身上没有放置伤害指示物的…」: no damage counters on it now.

abilityNames.description: 「拥有特性「祭典乐舞」的宝可梦」: an Ability printed with one of these names, currently in effect (JP Q&A バチンキー「ドンドンだいこ」: a cancelled Ability does not count).

targetState.description: pokemonState for a one-time choice or check of Pokémon (switch, Knock Out, healing), which may also read the remaining HP (II.D-16): remainingHpAtMost = 「剩余HP在「N」（点）以下（包含「N」）」／「剩余HP在「N」及以下」. Never in a continuous effect, whose HP changes could depend on it.

undamaged.description: 「身上没有放置伤害指示物的…」: no damage counters on it now.

energyUnitsAtLeast.description: 「对身上没有附有2个能量的宝可梦无法使用」: at least this many Energy units attached now.

damageCounters.description: 「身上放置有6个伤害指示物的宝可梦」: exactly this many damage counters on it now.

pokemonCount.description: Number of in-play Pokémon on the side(s) and zone that match the selector (current types) and state. excludeSelf leaves out the effect user's own Pokémon (「除这只宝可梦以外」).

retreatCost.description: 「【撤退】所需能量为4个的宝可梦」: only Pokémon whose current Retreat Cost is exactly this many Energy.

maximumHp.description: 「最大HP为「30」的备战宝可梦」: only Pokémon whose current maximum HP is exactly this (JP Q&A ププリン「ぷにぷにサークル」: not the remaining HP; an HP change counts). Never in a continuous condition.

energyFilter.description: Attached Energy cards matching the selector; with providedTypes, only Energy (units, or cards) currently providing one of those types.

pokemonSum.description: Sum of one count over one holder (who) or over a matching in-play set: damage counters, attached Energy cards or units (optionally filtered), or attached Tools.

tool.description: Only attached Tool cards matching this Trainer selector (「放有「X」」).

zoneCount.description: Number of cards in a player's zone at evaluation time. Only public zones (discard, Lost Zone) and hands may filter by card identity; deck and Prize cards are counts only. The opponent's hand is filtered only after a printed look at it earlier in the same Trainer or Ability program (the load guard).

choose.description: Validate the entire static AST, but evaluate only the selected branch's runtime facts.
